video_title: Hornets vs Nets: Liam McNeeley Postgame Media Availability | 10/6/2026

quotes.speaker: Liam McNeeley
quotes.summary_phrase: Liam McNeeley on the winning habits of veteran teammates
quotes.excerpt: Everything they do is about winning. So it's great to watch them in practice
quotes.quote: They are just so consistent every day in practice. They are always trying to win in practice when we play. They have winning habits. Everything they do is about winning. So it's great to watch them in practice and luckily for me today get to watch them in the game do what they do.
quotes.social_post: Liam McNeeley says watching his veteran teammates has been a masterclass in consistency. He noted that their winning habits in practice are what set the tone for the team.

quotes.speaker: Liam McNeeley
quotes.summary_phrase: Liam McNeeley on his G League development and physical growth
quotes.excerpt: The big thing that I was focusing on this off season was my physicality, getting stronger
quotes.quote: I spent a lot of time in Greensboro in the G League. They were great reps, they really helped me. I can see the progress I've made during this summer and this off season. I want to prove that I can stick in this league and the big thing that I was focusing on this off season was my physicality, getting stronger, putting weight on, and that will help me on both sides of the ball.
quotes.social_post: Liam McNeeley credits his G League stint in Greensboro for his recent progress. He says his main focus this offseason was improving his physicality and getting stronger to prove he can stick in the league.

quotes.speaker: Liam McNeeley
quotes.summary_phrase: Liam McNeeley on Hornets' offensive struggles against Brooklyn's defensive switching
quotes.excerpt: They were switching everything and our offense got stagnant which led to the turnovers
quotes.quote: They were switching everything and our offense got stagnant which led to the turnovers and just putting your head down. I had six turnovers, just can't happen. Two charges, other guys had charges. We just weren't moving the ball after an initial action. We just got to do better after actions more.
quotes.social_post: Liam McNeeley took accountability for the Hornets offensive struggles against the Nets. He admitted the team became stagnant against the switch heavy defense and noted that his six turnovers simply cannot happen.
